audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly names Hwei's CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability called that. His real kit is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment (the CC-paint slot: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw), R Spiraling Despair. The packet's own defect list confirms the page 'never names any of Hwei's abilities' correctly.
audit.why: This is the exact class of error the calibration set flags (fabricated ability names like 'Ares of Blaze' for Brand). It appears in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[3].t, report[5].t and report[9].t — every field that names his crowd control.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (CC Paints)' (or 'Subject: Torment (E, ...)') everywhere it appears, matching enemyAbilities.E.

audit.why: Level 6/first-item/late spikes are already grounded in real ability behavior (EW pool disengage, Radiance vs his burst, W-linked E stun) and match the level chart's Hwei-favoured-until-two-items shape.
Lane difficulty is stated clearly: Hwei out-ranges Taric with zero lockdown of his own until level 6+, and full-layer diffRating/carryRating (7/7.5) match the content-layer early/mid/late prose.

notes: Root cause: the page uses a fabricated Hwei ability name 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' throughout — real name per Data Dragon is Subject: Torment (E), the crowd-control paint slot (Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw). Fixed everywhere it appears in writable fields. dontsFull[0].t/d ('Trade at artillery range') and dosFull[0] were left alone — already grounded and not templated.
